description: CPP may not redesign, reparameterize, or revalidate any completed construct.
No thresholds, parameters, workflows, or comparison methods may be optimized after observing results.
CPP does not search for alpha, trading signals, entries, exits, or portfolio strategies.
Lead-lag or hierarchy evidence may be described as temporal association only unless causal identification is explicitly established.
Previous FSR conclusions are immutable inputs throughout CPP.
No statistical comparison may begin before CPP-000.5 is complete and approved.
